description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): ERFC.PRECISE on runs of 512 consecutive x with Excel's own exp(-fl(x*x)) beside it, so the implied x-rational F = ERFC/EXP is known to half an ulp and the noise of the rational can be studied without assuming a libm exp. A = x, B = ERFC.PRECISE(x), C = EXP(-(x*x)), D = x*x. Runs: run=0 xc=0.75 x0=0x1.8000000000000p-1 n=512 row=1; run=1 xc=1.5 x0=0x1.8000000000000p+0 n=512 row=513; run=2 xc=3.0 x0=0x1.8000000000000p+1 n=512 row=1025; run=3 xc=5.0 x0=0x1.4000000000000p+2 n=512 row=1537; run=4 xc=7.9 x0=0x1.f99999999999ap+2 n=512 row=2049; run=5 xc=12.0 x0=0x1.8000000000000p+3 n=512 row=2561; run=6 xc=20.0 x0=0x1.4000000000000p+4 n=512 row=3073; run=7 xc=26.0 x0=0x1.a000000000000p+4 n=512 row=3585
